# calendly.com

> Calendly simplifies scheduling with an intuitive automation platform that eliminates back‑and‑forth emails, helping you schedule meetings faster and grow your business



## **Product**

-   [Automated Scheduling (Simplified booking)](https://calendly.com/scheduling): Powerful online scheduling software that shows how Calendly automates the process of booking appointments and meetings, so you can save time and focus on more important work

-   [Calendly Features (Why choose Calendly)](https://calendly.com/features): Overview of Calendly’s scheduling platform and its key capabilities – from booking links and calendar sync to integrations and team features – illustrating why millions choose Calendly for easier scheduling

-   [Round Robin Scheduling](https://calendly.com/features/round-robin): Distribute meetings automatically across teammates based on availability

-   [Routing Forms](https://calendly.com/features/routing-forms): Qualify, route, and assign invitees to the right person or team

-   [Workflows](https://calendly.com/features/workflows): Automate reminders, follow-ups, and notifications around scheduled events

-   [Meeting Polls](https://calendly.com/features/meeting-polls): Let groups vote on preferred meeting times before booking

-   [Availability](https://calendly.com/features/availability): Configure working hours, buffers, limits, and scheduling rules

-   [Embed Calendly](https://calendly.com/features/embed): Add booking flows directly to websites and landing pages




## **Platform**

-   [Integrations](https://calendly.com/integration): Connect Calendly with 100+ popular apps and tools (Google, Outlook, Zoom, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) to streamline your workflows and boost productivity through scheduling automation

-   [Mobile Apps](https://calendly.com/features/mobile-apps): Calendly for iOS and Android lets you schedule and manage meetings on the go, with features like instant notifications, one-tap rescheduling, and sharing your availability from your phone

-   [Browser Extensions](https://calendly.com/features/browser-extensions): One-click access to Calendly from Chrome, Firefox, or Edge – find and share your scheduling links without leaving your email, LinkedIn, or web browser, making scheduling part of your workflow

-   [Admin Management](https://calendly.com/features/admin-management): Admin controls and visibility for teams – central dashboard to manage users and groups, lock standardized event types, enforce security settings, and monitor organization-wide scheduling activity

-   [Security](https://calendly.com/security): Learn about Calendly’s enterprise-grade security and compliance measures (SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, etc.), including SSO/SCIM user management, data encryption, audit logs, and other features that keep scheduling data safe

-   [Analytics](https://calendly.com/features/analytics): Built-in scheduling analytics that provide insights into your team’s meeting patterns – track metrics like popular meeting times, top performers, meeting volume, and trends to drive data-informed decisions

-   [Single Sign-On](https://calendly.com/features/sso): SSO support for secure authentication and enterprise identity management




## **Solutions by Business Size**

-   [For Individuals](https://calendly.com/solutions/individuals): See how freelancers and solopreneurs use Calendly’s personal scheduling links, custom availability, and automated reminders to save time and present a professional scheduling experience to clients

-   [For Small Businesses](https://calendly.com/solutions/small-business): Discover how small teams automate their meeting scheduling to free up time for growth – letting Calendly handle bookings, payments, and confirmations so you can focus on customers and projects

-   [For Enterprise](https://calendly.com/solutions/enterprise): Calendly’s solution for large companies – learn how 4 out of 5 Fortune 500 firms use Calendly to speed up sales cycles, improve client engagement, and manage organization-wide scheduling with advanced admin and security features

-   [Teams](https://calendly.com/teams): Shared scheduling features for collaborative teams and departments




## **Solutions by Team**

-   [Sales Teams](https://calendly.com/solutions/sales): Speed up your sales cycle by automating meeting bookings with prospects – Calendly helps reps fill their pipeline faster (via website embeds and outbound links), eliminate scheduling friction, and book more demos and follow-ups to close deals quicker

-   [Marketing Teams](https://calendly.com/solutions/marketing): Convert more leads into meetings – Calendly lets marketing teams embed scheduling directly in campaigns, landing pages, and emails so interested prospects can instantly book with sales, boosting lead conversion rates and pipeline generation

-   [Customer Success Teams](https://calendly.com/solutions/customer-success): Increase customer retention and satisfaction by making it easy to connect – Calendly helps CS teams schedule onboarding, training, and check-in calls at the right time, automate reminders and follow-ups, and route customers to the right team member for faster support

-   [Recruiting Teams](https://calendly.com/solutions/recruiting): Accelerate your hiring process by simplifying interview scheduling – Calendly coordinates calendars for candidates and interviewers, integrates with ATS tools, sends automated reminders, and allows self-scheduling, helping recruiters reduce time-to-hire and deliver a better candidate experience

-   [IT](https://calendly.com/solutions/it): Organize internal support, consultations, and technical scheduling workflows




## **Solutions by Industry**

-   [Education](https://calendly.com/solutions/education): Simplified scheduling for schools and universities – learn how Calendly helps with booking student advising appointments, admissions interviews, office hours, and campus tours, making support services more accessible and reducing administrative overhead

-   [Technology](https://calendly.com/solutions/technology): How tech companies use Calendly as a competitive edge – create more sales opportunities, improve customer success touchpoints, and recruit top talent faster by using scheduling automation to connect with prospects, clients, and candidates seamlessly

-   [Financial Services](https://calendly.com/solutions/financial-services): Modernize client scheduling in banking, wealth management, and insurance – Calendly provides secure, easy appointment booking that delights clients, enables advisors to spend more time advising (not scheduling), and supports compliance needs in financial industries

-   [Professional Services](https://calendly.com/solutions/professional-services): See how consulting firms, law practices, accounting agencies, and staffing companies streamline meeting coordination – Calendly helps deliver a best-in-class client experience by reducing back-and-forth scheduling, increasing billable time, and speeding up client interactions




## **Compare Calendly vs Alternatives**

-   [Calendly vs. Google Calendar Appointment Scheduling](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-versus-google-calendar): Head-to-head comparison of Google’s native appointment scheduling feature versus Calendly’s more powerful scheduling platform for booking meetings with clients and external contacts

-   [Calendly vs. Microsoft Bookings](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-microsoft-bookings): Compare Calendly with Microsoft Bookings in terms of ease-of-use, calendar integration, customization, and team scheduling capabilities to determine which tool better fits your scheduling needs

-   [Calendly vs. Zoom Scheduler](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-zoom-scheduler): Learn how Calendly’s dedicated scheduling solution stacks up against Zoom’s meeting scheduler add-on – including differences in features like reminders, calendar syncing, and scheduling for group meetings

-   [Calendly vs. Chili Piper](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-chili-piper): See the differences between Calendly and Chili Piper for scheduling and routing meetings in sales and marketing workflows – from round-robin assignments and CRM integration to user experience and pricing

-   [Calendly vs. Salesforce Scheduler](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-salesforce-scheduler): Compare Calendly’s scheduling automation with Salesforce’s built-in scheduler to find out which provides greater flexibility, integration, and efficiency for booking meetings with prospects and customers

-   [Calendly vs. HubSpot Meetings](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-hubspot-meetings): Calendly and HubSpot’s meeting tool go head-to-head – understand how each handles scheduling links, embed options, contact integration, and what might work best for your sales/marketing team’s meeting scheduling

-   [Calendly vs. Acuity Scheduling](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-acuity): Evaluate the differences in features, client experience, and customization between Calendly and Acuity Scheduling (Squarespace Scheduling) to determine the right fit for appointment booking in your business

-   [Calendly vs. YouCanBookMe](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-youcanbookme): Detailed comparison of YouCanBookMe and Calendly, examining scheduling features, team capabilities, integrations, and ease of use to help you choose the better online scheduling tool

-   [Calendly vs. Doodle](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-doodle): Discover how Calendly’s automated scheduling (with set availability and calendar sync) compares to Doodle’s group poll scheduling approach, and which is more efficient for organizing meetings

-   [Calendly vs. TidyCal](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-tidycal): Find out which scheduling app is right for you by comparing Calendly with AppSumo’s TidyCal – including differences in interface, scheduling link options, calendar integrations, and pricing for small businesses

-   [Calendly vs. Clockwise](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-clockwise): Compare Calendly’s meeting scheduling capabilities to Clockwise’s intelligent calendar assistant – see how each tool approaches scheduling conflicts, availability, and productivity for busy professionals

-   [Calendly vs. Outreach Meetings](https://calendly.com/blog/calendly-vs-outreach-meetings): Learn which tool better streamlines the scheduling of sales meetings – Calendly’s standalone scheduling platform or Outreach’s built-in meetings feature – by comparing features for booking links, reminders, and CRM workflow

## **Developer Documentation**

-   [Developer Portal](https://developer.calendly.com/): Entry point for Calendly API documentation and developer resources

-   [API Reference](https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs): Reference for endpoints, schemas, authentication, and request formats

-   [Webhook Subscriptions](https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs/0d2530329cf1f-webhook-subscriptions): Create and manage webhook subscriptions for Calendly events

-   [Event Types](https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs/6a1be82aef359-list-event-types): Retrieve and manage event type data through the API

-   [Scheduled Events](https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs/3f3f9c9b5c4f4-list-events): Access scheduled event records and related metadata

-   [Invitees](https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs/eb8ee72701f99-list-event-invitees): Retrieve invitee details for scheduled events

-   [OAuth Applications](https://developer.calendly.com/create-apps): Build OAuth apps and connect Calendly with external systems

-   [Developer Guides](https://developer.calendly.com/how-to-guides): Implementation guides for common Calendly integration patterns




## **Integrations**

-   [Google Calendar](https://calendly.com/integrations/google-calendar): Sync availability and events with Google Calendar

-   [Microsoft Outlook](https://calendly.com/integrations/outlook): Connect Outlook calendars and scheduling workflows

-   [Zoom](https://calendly.com/integrations/zoom): Automatically create Zoom meetings for booked events

-   [Salesforce](https://calendly.com/integrations/salesforce): Connect scheduling data with Salesforce records and workflows

-   [HubSpot](https://calendly.com/integrations/hubspot): Sync meetings and contact activity with HubSpot

-   [Stripe](https://calendly.com/integrations/stripe): Accept payments when invitees book appointments

-   [PayPal](https://calendly.com/integrations/paypal): Collect booking payments through PayPal integrations

-   [Slack](https://calendly.com/integrations/slack): Send scheduling notifications and updates into Slack
